author: Jennifer Osburn Thompson
text: My Diabetic Educator told me last week that Libre 2 Plus and Omnipod running in automatic mode or close loop is having a lot of recent problems and glitches. I wear a Libre 3+ and Omnipod and I put them wherever I want to on my body and don’t have any problems. However, I do run in manual mode and not automatic. I know Libre 2+ is the only you can run in automatic. ￼￼😩

text: Yes I can’t place them too far apart so I use same arm for 15days then just rotate the cannula site ie turn it a few mm then place on opposite arm for the next 15days x
